cases.claim: This model has neither recurrence nor convolution and needs injected token-position information.
cases.rationale: Both absence and the rationale are explicit.

evidence.excerpt:
Since our model contains no recurrence and no convolution, in order for the model to make use of the
order of the sequence, we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the
tokens in the sequence.

cases.claim: Query head count must be divisible by key/value head count, and key and value head counts must be equal.
cases.rationale: The two equations express those constraints.

evidence.excerpt:
Constraints for GQA:
number_of_heads_query % number_of_heads_key_value == 0 and,
number_of_heads_key == number_of_heads_value

cases.claim: GQA requires the number of query heads not to be divisible by the key/value head count.
cases.rationale: The modulo constraint requires divisibility.

evidence.excerpt:
Constraints for GQA:
number_of_heads_query % number_of_heads_key_value == 0 and,
number_of_heads_key == number_of_heads_value

cases.claim: Enabling GQA guarantees faster inference on all hardware.
cases.rationale: Head-count constraints do not establish performance guarantees.

evidence.excerpt:
Constraints for GQA:
number_of_heads_query % number_of_heads_key_value == 0 and,
number_of_heads_key == number_of_heads_value

during training.
